_comment: Narrow allowlist for check-hardcoded-ui.mjs. Only genuine proper nouns, platform/provider names, technical constants and non-user-facing developer text belong here. Never add a translatable sentence.

reasons.src/lib/: API clients and pure helpers. These modules must not hold rendered prose: user-visible text is produced through t() at the call site (see lib/apiErrors.ts, and permissions.getRoleDisplayName which takes t as a parameter). Verified in the browser: no Vietnamese leaks into the English UI from here.
reasons.src/app/dashboard/settings/test-interact: developer scratch component: not a route (no page.tsx), not imported anywhere, never rendered to a user
reasons._brand_and_format_examples: 'Aa' is a font-preview glyph. 'Nope360 Intelligence' / 'NOPE360 INTELLIGENCE' are the report watermark brand lockup. 'Facebook / Instagram' names two platforms. 'SHA-256 HASH' and 'IP:' are technical labels. '.custom-class { color: red; }', '1900 xxxx' and '+84 xxx xxx xxx' are format examples inside input placeholders. 'Top 10' reads identically in Vietnamese.
reasons._technical_constants: AIzaSy... is the literal prefix of a Google API key shown as an input placeholder. TARGETS:/QUEUE:/ACTIVE_JOBS:/LAST_SCAN:/SUCCESS:/PING:/[ERR] are tokens in the deliberately code-style worker readout on the Scan page, alongside already-neutral tokens such as SYS.WORKER // ONLINE. NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL:/API_BASE_URL (resolved):/capabilities URL:/manual-scan URL: are environment and endpoint identifiers in the collapsed developer debug panel. '* * * * * (m h d M w)' is the cron field-order legend. 'tag1, tag2, tag3...' is an example token list. EchoMind is a product name.
